Optical communications is becoming a core capability for high-rate space networking, and the hardware that makes it work has to hold tight thermal stability and precise optical interfaces while surviving launch and years on orbit. Orientaci v mezinárodních normách a standardech (např. IEC 61439, UL 508A). Zkušenosti s měřicí a testovací technikou. Schopnost analytického myšlení a řešení technických problémů. Dobré komunikační dovednosti a schopnost spolupráce napříč týmy. Samostatnost, organizační schopnosti a zvládání více projektů současně český a anglický jazyk – aktivně   Co Eaton nabízí:     Motivační mzdu a atraktivní balíček benefitů (příspěvek na penzijní připojištění, příspěvek na dopravu, plně hrazené stravné a další) Flexibilní pracovní dobu Možnosti vzdělávání a profesního rozvoje – investujeme do našich zaměstnanců prostřednictvím kurzů a školení na různých úrovních Příležitost růstu a zapojení do zajímavých projektů (např. datová centra, speciální zákaznické zakázky ) #LI-KF1
descriptions.872318514717354: About Lucid At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.   We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility. The LV Test and Validation team verifies the reliability, electrical performance, and compliance of low-voltage vehicle electronics. The team works with LVEE hardware design engineers and internal and external laboratories to produce decision-ready validation evidence. Its work spans component testing, test automation, failure investigation, and laboratory operations.    Role: As a Sr. EMC Test Engineer, you will deliver automotive EMC/EMI validation and compliance evidence for vehicle electronics. Reporting to the Low-Voltage Test and Validation manager, you will work closely with design engineers and laboratory partners to complete DVP commitments on time. You will combine hands-on execution with disciplined analysis, documentation, and issue closure. Success in the first year means repeatable tests, complete evidence, and timely resolution of issues affecting current and future vehicle programs.     EMC Validation: Test and validate Lucid electronic modules against automotive EMI and EMC requirements.   Design Collaboration: Partner with design engineers during pre-DV, DV and PV EMC testing and provide actionable ECU EMC design recommendations based on schematic and PCB layout review.   Test Planning: Develop component-level EMC plans, procedures, requirements, and EMC test setups with cross-functional engineering partners.   Laboratory Execution: Plan, schedule, and conduct testing in internal and external laboratories to support DVP commitments.   Compliance Evidence: Evaluate EMC test data and reports, interpret applicable standards, and communicate compliance results, corrective-action needs and EMC risk assessments.   Laboratory Capability: Support selection, procurement, setup, and calibration of EMC-related equipment and maintain controlled documentation.     Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering and at least 5 years of EMC testing experience; automotive experience is a plus.   Extensive experience with LISNs, antennas, spectrum analyzers, EMI receivers, oscilloscopes, amplifiers, and related EMC laboratory equipment.   Familiarity with FCC/CISPR emission and immunity test environments and understanding of FCC Parts 15, CISPR 25, ISO 11452 series, ISO 7637 series, ISO 10605, international regulations such as UNECE Reg 10, and automotive OEM-specific standards.   Experience evaluating EMC test data and reports and interpreting standards and compliance requirements.   Experience with Confluence and JIRA, excellent technical and non-technical communication, and an ownership-oriented approach to collaborative engineering.   Preferred: Master's degree in Electrical Engineering.   Experience taking an automotive product from concept to final PPAP.   Experience with TILE EMC test SW       At Lucid, we don’t just welcome diversity - we celebrate it!…
descriptions.873339414156154: As an EDS Integration Engineer for the Advanced EV Team, you will be at the forefront of defining the "nervous system" for our next-generation Model e products. You will be responsible for the end-to-end vehicle-side electrical wire harness design and physical integration, serving as a critical link between architectural theory and vehicle reality. This role is essential to the development of a Software-Defined Vehicle (SDV), where you will optimize the intersection of hardware, software, and mechanical packaging. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the harness architecture is efficient, manufacturable, and robust, while remaining hands-on during lab-car and vehicle "bring-up" phases to troubleshoot and validate your designs.  What you’ll do… •    Zonal Architecture Leadership: Drive the electrical wiring system design from concept to production, focusing on the transition toward Zonal power and data distribution to minimize mass and maximize vehicle efficiency.  •    Multi-Voltage & Power Distribution: Architect and integrate diverse voltage platforms, leading wire sizing, fuse coordination, and terminal selection based on steady-state and transient power profiles to ensure robust power delivery.  •    High-Speed Data Management: Design for signal integrity across the vehicle’s data backbone, managing shielded circuits for ADAS sensors, Automotive Ethernet, and other high-bandwidth communication protocols.  •    System Optimization & Partitioning: Partner with Subsystem engineers to establish harness partitioning and complexity strategies to minimize wire count, optimize cost, and reduce weight—critical metrics for EV range.  •    Functional Safety & Topology: Influence the design of grounding and network topologies while collaborating on Functional Safety (ISO 26262) assessments to ensure the EDS architecture supports safety-critical features.  •    ECAD Schematic Development: Develop logical and physical electrical schematics using professional ECAD tools (e.g., Capital, Zuken), owning the technical resolution of integration issues as they arise.  •    Hands-on Integration & Bring-up: Support Labcar and prototype vehicle builds as the primary lead for electrical bring-up, circuit troubleshooting, and validating system-level changes in a real-world environment.  •    Manufacturing & Innovation: Review 2D drawings and 3D routing to ensure supplier readiness while investigating new harness technologies (e.g., busbars or automated manufacturing) to push the boundaries of EV design.    You’ll have… •    Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related technical field.  •    5+ years of experience in EDS design and development within the automotive, aerospace, or complex robotics industries.  •    5+ years of hands-on experience with professional EDS ECAD tooling (e.g., Mentor Capital, Zuken E3, or Vector Preevision).  •    Proven experience in a mass-production environment, taking a product from initial concept through Job 1/launch.  •    Deep understanding of Electrical Engineering fundamentals (Ohm’s Law, voltage drop, thermal management, and circuit protection).   Even better you may have… •    Advanced EV Expertise: Experience with High Voltage (HV) DC power distribution and the challenges of integrating diverse voltage architectures.  •    Data Integrity: Familiarity with high-speed data requirements, including shielding, twisting, and connector selection for Automotive Ethernet or LVDS.  •    Prototyping Skills: Experience with vehicle instrumentation (data loggers, current clamps, oscilloscopes) in a controlled lab or test-track environment.  •    Agile Mindset: Familiarity with Confluence and Jira for task management in a fast-paced, iterative development cycle.  •    Complexity Management: Demonstrated ability to manage high-variant harness architectures and "feature-to-pin" mapping.  •    Analytical Rigor: Experience performing DFM (Design for Manufacturing)…

This role is responsible for developing and maintaining controls engineering standards, design criteria, controls architectures, and technical requirements while ensuring controls solutions are reliably integrated into data center design, construction, commissioning, and operations. The Senior Controls Engineer partners closely with Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Operations, IT, Security, external consultants, and customers to deliver scalable, standardized, and operationally effective controls solutions that support business and customer requirements. Responsibilities Controls Engineering & Design Serve as the engineering lead and subject matter expert for BMS, EPMS, and related controls systems supporting mission-critical facilities. Develop, review, and maintain controls design criteria, engineering standards, sequences of operation, controls narratives, points lists, and related engineering documentation. Support development of controls architecture and ensure designs align with operational, customer, and Engineering requirements. Review drawings, specifications, calculations, and consultant deliverables for technical accuracy, completeness, and compliance with project requirements. Identify controls-related scope gaps, design risks, and integration challenges during the design process and develop appropriate solutions. Requirements Development & Customer Support Translate customer requirements, operational requirements, and technical standards into clear engineering design criteria and controls requirements. Support customer design reviews and participate in technical discussions with hyperscale, enterprise, and colocation customers. Coordinate closely with design consultants and Engineers of Record to ensure customer requirements are incorporated into project deliverables. Support development of standardized controls requirements and design approaches across CyrusOne's global data center portfolio. Collaborate with Construction, Commissioning, Operations, Security, and IT teams to ensure controls-related requirements are understood and effectively executed. Participate in startup, commissioning, integrated systems testing, and validation activities to verify conformance with design intent. Remain engaged throughout project execution to ensure controls systems are delivered in accordance with approved engineering requirements and customer commitments. Cross-Functional Collaboration Serve as the primary engineering interface for controls-related discussions between Engineering, Construction, Operations, IT, Security, and customer stakeholders. Collaborate with internal engineering disciplines to integrate controls requirements into overall facility design. Provide technical guidance and recommendations on controls technologies, design standards, and industry best practices. Support continuous improvement efforts aimed at improving reliability, consistency, scalability, and standardization of controls solutions across the portfolio.
